release.title: AR6 GWPs and device leak rates as sealed in the TonyAI TR factor package (§4.6): supplementary edition for fire suppression in Türkiye; the dry powder or foam zero is a TonyAI owner decision (UAT round 4, BUG-12), not from IPCC or the package
release.licence: IPCC public domain (publicly available international standard)
release.notes: Supplementary: the Fire Suppression category. Built by packages/db/factor-releases/tr-fire-2026-11/build.mjs from the TR factor package's §4.6 (docs/md_docs/Revision MD.md), which it neither supersedes nor overlaps: no other release prices Fire Suppression. CO2, FM200 (HFC-227ea) and SF6 are the package's AR6 GWPs, and the three leak rates are its fire device rates. The dry powder or foam row is zero by the owner's UAT round 4 decision (BUG-12), not from the package. Open for the external reviewer: whether the 4% and 2% rates apply to CO2 equipment, and the zero. publishedAt is this edition's compilation date; reviewedAt the owner's approval (Decisions 2026-11-24 (fifth)).

factors.methodology: AR6 100-year GWP of CO2: 1 kgCO2e per kg released; the capacity method prices the released mass (D7)
factors.source: IPCC AR6 WGI Table 7.15, via TR factor package TONYAI-EF-TR-UK-2026.11-AR6-SEALED (docs/md_docs/Revision MD.md) §4.6

factors.methodology: Not a measured emission factor: the zero states that a dry powder or foam agent holds no greenhouse gas as its extinguishing agent, so any released mass of it is 0 kgCO2e. A CO2 propellant cartridge is a CO2 line of its own. It lets such a record be calculated, with its lines and evidence, rather than left without a figure. A missing factor is never read as zero.
